title: Enhancement Mental Ability
author: Dan Leo
description: Mental age ability describes how your thinking, reasoning, and emotional maturity compare to what is typical for people at different ages. It is not the same as your birth certificate age. Someone who is 25 might show the calm judgment and planning skills of a 40-year-old, while another person might enjoy the playful curiosity of a teenager well into adulthood. Mental age draws on things like problem-solving, memory, decision-making, self-control, and how you handle stress and relationships. These traits shift with life experience, environment, and personality, so your mental age can feel different from one day to the next. If you are curious where you stand, you can try a quick, fun assessment at https://mentalagecheck.com/ and see how your answers compare to different age groups. Treat the result as a light-hearted guide to self-reflection rather than a scientific diagnosis, and use it as a starting point for understanding your own habits, strengths, and growth areas.

This podcast is for men and women in midlife. The season when perimenopause, menopause, low testosterone, sleep, energy, muscle, mood and libido all start pulling on each other at once.


You'll discover what actually changes in your body after 35, what your labs do and don't tell you, what your choices are, and how to ask better questions at your next appointment.


Most people here talk about sex hormones only. The ones who talk about metabolism call it longevity. You can't separate them, because you're a whole person.

Ernest is a lonely young boy living with three elderly aunts who struggle to understand his sensitive imagination and longing for companionship. Inside an old English church, he becomes fascinated by a mysterious marble figure of a child supporting the baptismal font. What begins as an innocent attachment gradually develops into something extraordinary when Ernest discovers that his silent stone companion may possess a life of its own. As dreams and reality begin to merge, the marble child offers Ernest the friendship and understanding missing from his ordinary world. But when a terrible danger threatens the church and those he loves, Ernest faces a choice that will test the extraordinary bond between them. This atmospheric British supernatural classic explores living statues, childhood loneliness, mysterious friendships, and the unsettling possibility that seemingly lifeless objects can awaken. Combining Gothic atmosphere with dark fantasy and emotional storytelling, The Marble Child reveals E. Nesbit's remarkable talent for transforming childhood imagination into a mysterious and unforgettable supernatural experience.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo by Alexandre Dumas
author: Gates of Imagination
description:
Marseille, 1815. Edmond Dantès is nineteen, about to be made captain of his own ship and about to marry the girl he loves. Three men want what he has: his command, his fiancée, and his silence. A letter is written, a magistrate buries the truth to protect his own father, and Dantès disappears into the island fortress of the Château d’If without ever learning what he is accused of.

Fourteen years later a man climbs out of the sea off the coast of Italy. He has a dead priest’s education, a fortune from a buried hoard on the island of Monte Cristo, and a plan that will take years to unfold. One by one he enters the lives of the men who buried him — now a banker, a prosecutor and a count of France — and begins, patiently and almost invisibly, to take everything from them.

First published between 1844 and 1846, The Count of Monte Cristo is Alexandre Dumas’s greatest novel and the most famous revenge story ever written: a sweeping adventure of betrayal, imprisonment, hidden treasure and ruthless retribution that has never been out of print.

Listen to the complete, unabridged audiobook of this masterpiece of French literature.

In a distant kingdom ruled by a powerful and unpredictable king, accused criminals must choose between two identical doors in a public arena. Behind one waits a beautiful woman whom the accused must marry; behind the other lurks a ferocious tiger certain to bring a violent death. When the king discovers that his beloved daughter has fallen in love with a young man beneath her royal standing, he condemns the forbidden lover to face this cruel trial. But the princess secretly discovers what lies behind each door. Torn between saving the man she loves and watching him marry another woman, she must make an impossible choice. As the young man looks to her for guidance, one silent gesture determines his fate. This thought-provoking American literary classic explores love, betrayal, jealousy, human nature, and the uncertain boundaries between justice and cruelty. Famous for its mysterious ending, The Lady, or the Tiger? remains one of literature's most intriguing short stories.

A masterpiece of English literature, A Christmas Carol explores generosity, poverty, family, compassion, forgiveness, and the transformative power of the Christmas spirit.

title: The Black Dahlia Murder
author: Jacky
description:
In January 1947, Los Angeles became the center of one of America's most disturbing and mysterious murder investigations. A young woman named Elizabeth Short was found murdered in a vacant lot, and the shocking circumstances of her death captured the attention of the entire nation. Newspapers quickly gave her the nickname "The Black Dahlia," transforming her tragic story into one of the most infamous unsolved cases in American criminal history.

This two-part true crime podcast explores the life of Elizabeth Short, the circumstances surrounding her disappearance and murder, the investigation that followed, and the numerous unanswered questions that continue to surround her case.

The first episode introduces Elizabeth Short, her dreams of Hollywood, her final known movements, and the discovery that shocked Los Angeles. The second episode examines the police investigation, suspicious letters, false confessions, possible suspects, and the theories that have kept the mystery alive for decades.

Through historical details and investigative storytelling, Shadows of Justice separates documented facts from speculation while exploring how media sensationalism transformed a young woman's identity into a lasting mystery.

Nearly eight decades later, one question remains: Who killed Elizabeth Short?

title: A Conversation About Schizophrenia
author: Hearst StoryStudio
description:
In A Conversation About Schizophrenia, host Chloe Addleson is joined by Desiree Matthews, a board-certified psychiatric nurse practitioner. She is also the founder of Different Mental Health Program, a multi-state tele-psychiatry practice dedicated to patient-centered mental health care. Throughout her career, Desiree has focused on treating schizophrenia and other serious mental illnesses, with a passion for early intervention, relapse prevention, and helping patients achieve long-term recovery. In this episode, Desiree discusses the evolving landscape of schizophrenia treatment, the importance of individualized care, and how new approaches are helping improve outcomes for patients, in light of the FDA’s recent approval of WELTRUZA™  (olanzapine) for extended-release injectable suspension for the treatment of schizophrenia in adults.


APPROVED USE

WELTRUZATM (olanzapine) for extended-release injectable suspension is a prescription medicine used in adults for the treatment of schizophrenia. 

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

What is the most important information I should know about WELTRUZA? 

WELTRUZA can cause serious side effects, including an increased risk of death in elderly people who have lost touch with reality (psychosis) due to confusion and memory loss (dementia). WELTRUZA is not for the treatment of people with dementia-related psychosis.

WELTRUZA may cause serious side effects, including:

  • Post-injection delirium/sedation syndrome (PDSS) is a serious problem that can happen when too much olanzapine enters the bloodstream too quickly. PDSS has happened in people who received another extended-release olanzapine medicine by injection into their muscles (intramuscularly). WELTRUZA is injected under the skin (subcutaneously). It is not known whether PDSS can happen with WELTRUZA. PDSS with an extended-release intramuscular injection has led to hospitalization, has happened within the first 3 hours of injection, but also happened after 3 hours of injection, and has the risk each time an injection is received. Tell your healthcare provider right away or go to the nearest emergency room if you get signs or symptoms of PDSS, including more sleepiness than usual, dizziness, confusion or disorientation, trouble walking or talking, stiff muscles or shakiness, weakness, feeling grouchy or angry, feeling anxious or nervous, increased blood pressure, seizures (convulsions), or passing out.
  • Strokes in elderly people (cerebral problems) that can lead to death.
  • Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS). NMS is a serious condition that can lead to death. Seek medical attention right away if you have any of these symptoms: high fever, stiff muscles, confusion, changes in pulse, heart rate, or blood pressure, increased sweating.
  • Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS). DRESS is an allergic reaction that can cause death that may affect your skin or other parts of your body including your liver, kidney, lungs, or heart.  Contact your healthcare provider right away if you experience any signs or symptoms of DRESS, including fever, skin rash or blistering or peeling skin, swelling of face, glands, or other body parts, cough or trouble breathing, chest pain, yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark urine or changes in urination. 
  • Problems with your metabolism that may include high blood sugar (hyperglycemia), diabetes mellitus, changes in the fat levels in your blood (dyslipidemia), and weight gain. Extremely high blood sugar can lead to coma or death. If you have diabetes or are at risk of diabetes (e.g., obesity, family history of diabetes), your healthcare provider should check your blood sugar before you start and during treatment with WELTRUZA. Call your healthcare provider if you have symptoms of high blood sugar, including feeling very thirsty, hungry, sick to your stomach, weak or tired, or confused; needing to urinate more than usual; or your breath smells fruity.
  • Uncontrolled facial or body movements (tardive dyskinesia) that may not go away, even if you stop receiving WELTRUZA. Tell your healthcare provider if you get any body movements that you cannot control.  
  • Decreased blood pressure (orthostatic hypotension). You may feel dizzy or lightheaded, get a fast or slow heartbeat, or faint, when you rise too quickly from a sitting or lying position. Drinking alcohol and using other medicines that make you dizzy can increase your risk for orthostatic hypotension. Avoid drinking alcohol during treatment with WELTRUZA.
  • Falls. WELTRUZA may make you sleepy or dizzy, may cause a decrease in your blood pressure when changing position (orthostatic hypotension), and can slow your thinking and motor skills which may lead to falls that can cause fractures or other injuries.
  • Low white blood cell counts. Your healthcare provider may do white blood cell count tests during your first few months of treatment with WELTRUZA.
  • Difficulty swallowing that can cause food or liquid to get into your lungs.  
  • Seizures (convulsions). 
  • Sleepiness, drowsiness, feeling tired, difficulty thinking and doing normal activities. Do not drive, operate machinery, or do other dangerous activities until you know how WELTRUZA affects you.
  • Problems controlling your body temperature so that you feel too warm. Avoid getting overheated or dehydrated.
  • Certain side effects from the way WELTRUZA works in your body such as constipation, dry mouth, fast heartbeat, urinary retention, or prostate and bowel problems. Your risk is increased if you take other medicines that also cause these side effects.
  • Increased prolactin levels in your blood (hyperprolactinemia). WELTRUZA can cause a rise in the blood levels of a hormone called prolactin that may cause side effects including missed menstrual periods, a reversible reduction in fertility in females who are able to become pregnant, leakage of milk from the breasts, development of breasts in men, or problems with erection.
  • The most common side effects of olanzapine in patients with schizophrenia include weight gain, sleepiness, headache, and constipation. Injection site reactions, including hardness, pain, redness, itching, and swelling, were reported with WELTRUZA.

These are not all the possible side effects with WELTRUZA. Tell your healthcare provider if you have any side effect that does not go away. For more information, ask your healthcare provider or pharmacist. 

Before receiving WELTRUZA, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions, including if you:

  • have or had diabetes or high blood sugar 
  • have or had high levels of total cholesterol, LDL cholesterol, or triglycerides, or low HDL levels in your blood  
  • have or had low or high blood pressure  
  • have or had heart problems or stroke
  • are dehydrated 
  • have or had a low white blood cell count
  • have or had seizures (convulsions)  
  • have or had problems with urination or prostate problems 
  • have Alzheimer’s disease  
  • have or had constipation or bowel obstruction  
  • have or had breast cancer  
  • are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. WELTRUZA may harm your unborn baby. Receiving WELTRUZA during your third trimester of pregnancy may cause your baby to have abnormal muscle movements or withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, stiffness or floppiness, tremors, sleepiness, and breathing or feeding problems after birth. Talk to your healthcare provider about the risks to your baby if you receive WELTRUZA during pregnancy.
  • If you become pregnant during treatment with WELTRUZA, talk to your healthcare provider about registering with the National Pregnancy Registry for Atypical Antipsychotics. You can register by calling 1-866-961-2388 or go to http://womensmentalhealth.org/clinical-and-research-programs/pregnancyregistry/.  
  • are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. WELTRUZA passes into breast milk. If you breastfeed during treatment with WELTRUZA, tell your healthcare provider if your baby is very sleepy, irritable, is feeding poorly, or gets tremors or abnormal muscle movements. Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby during treatment with WELTRUZA.  

Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines

author: Richard Dunn
description:
In The Practices of a Healthy Leader, Dr. Rick Dunn and Brad Raby explore the hidden causes of leadership exhaustion and burnout.
Using practical examples and personal stories, they unpack the difference between stewardship and control, showing how anxiety often reveals where leaders are trying to prove their worth.
This show offers a simple reflective practice to help leaders notice where they became reactive, name the fear underneath it, return to the truth they've forgotten, and take a small step of trust.
The conversation invites leaders into a healthier, freer way of leading—one rooted in surrender, identity, and the steady practice of spiritual and emotional health.

author: BibleTalk MN
description:
I make faith videos for people at the end of it.
I was in and out of active addiction for 25 years. I got high for the last time in a jail cell on July 25, 2025. Sober since that day, cancer-free after surgery. Some of what I'm in isn't finished.
So this isn't a show about how it all worked out. It's about what you do while it hasn't.
One subject an episode, with the Bible open. No clichés, and nothing here uses fear. If you're asking whether you're too far gone, the answer is no.
Not a pastor, not a counselor.
More at bibletalkmn.com
This has been BibleTalk MN. Grace and peace.

author: DataMasque Ltd
description:
What if the biggest opportunity in AI isn't the technology itself... but the data behind it?


And what if protecting that data didn't have to slow innovation down?


Welcome to Beyond the Masque, where data meets innovation.


Every day, organizations are navigating big questions.


How do we unlock the full potential of AI while protecting customer privacy?


How do we turn complex, disconnected data into a competitive advantage?


And what does responsible innovation actually look like in the real world?


On this podcast, I'll sit down with technology leaders, data experts, and innovators who are challenging conventional thinking and finding new ways forward.


We'll explore everything from AI adoption to data security, privacy, and the emerging technologies transforming how businesses operate.


Just honest conversations, fresh perspectives, and practical insights from the people doing the work.


Because the future of innovation isn't about choosing between progress and protection.


It's about finding ways to achieve both.


This is Beyond the Masque.


Follow the show on Apple Podcasts or Spotify, and join us as we explore what's next.

Darcy Kopas and Robin Flynn, shamanic practitioners and founders of Visionary Hearts, guide you through the convergence of ancient wisdom traditions, neurosomatics, new science, and the infinite power of the heart. 


Visionary Hearts exists to serve the quiet yet invincible revolution of love that is awakening right now through countless souls. A revolution of spiritual sovereignty, of embodied reconnection to the sacred dimension of earth and cosmos, a renaissance of awakened heart culture.


This is a time of great change, a time of global Pachakuti. A time of breakdown and a time of almost infinite possibility. A wondrous, brilliant and terrifying choice point. And it is up to each of us to choose how we add our unique Soul Power to this collective death and rebirth.


Through guided Lightseed Activations, deep teachings, and heartfelt conversation, each  offering we share here is a prayer of blessing from our hearts to yours, to resource you, to fortify you, and to help you remember, even if just for a breath, the gift of life, so that you can meet your field of service and your relationships with love and presence.

Hosted by Matt Alexander, the show explores personal growth, emotional awareness, meditation, relationships, and what it means to align mind, body, and soul in a modern world that rarely teaches men how to do so.
Through personal reflections and conversations with other men on their own journeys, this podcast invites you to release ego-driven narratives, embrace vulnerability, and discover a more authentic, grounded version of yourself.
If you’ve ever felt successful on the outside but disconnected on the inside, you’re not alone. This space is for reflection, growth, and remembering that we’re all in this together.

title: Your Marketing Mechanics Podcast | Real Talk. Smart Strategy. Marketing That Actually Works.
author: Staci Cretu
description:
Marketing advice is everywhere. But figuring out what actually works for your business? That's a different story.

Welcome to **Your Marketing Mechanics: Real Talk. Smart Strategy. Marketing That Actually Works.** — the podcast for business owners, entrepreneurs, founders, and marketers who want to stop guessing, start making smarter decisions, and build marketing that drives real growth.

We're getting under the hood of marketing to break down the strategies, systems, tools, and tactics that help businesses attract the right customers, generate qualified leads, build stronger brands, and turn marketing investments into measurable results.

Whether you're running a small business, scaling a startup, leading a growing company, or trying to do more with a limited marketing budget, we're here to help you figure out what matters, what works, and what's just another expensive distraction.

What you'll hear on Your Marketing Mechanics:

- Marketing Strategy & Business Growth: How to build a practical marketing plan, identify your ideal customers, stand out from competitors, and invest in the right growth opportunities.
- Branding & Positioning: Why customers choose one business over another and how to build a brand people recognize, trust, and remember.
- AI & Marketing Technology:*Real-world applications of artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging tools that can save time, improve productivity, and make marketing more effective.
- SEO & AI Search Visibility: How to get found online as traditional search evolves, AI-powered discovery grows, and customer buying behavior changes.
- Demand Generation & Lead Generation: What it really takes to attract qualified prospects, create demand, and turn interest into revenue.
- Content, Social Media & Digital Marketing: How to create content that connects, choose the right channels, and stop chasing vanity metrics.
- Marketing Budgets, Metrics & ROI: Where to spend, what to measure, and how to know whether your marketing is actually paying off.
- Entrepreneurship & Behind-the-Scenes Lessons: Honest conversations about growing businesses, marketing mistakes, lessons learned, and the things nobody tells you about building a successful company.

We're not here to convince you that every business needs to be on TikTok, spend thousands on ads, or adopt every new AI tool that hits the market.

And we're definitely not here to make marketing more complicated than it needs to be.

Expect candid conversations, practical advice, real examples, expert perspectives, a healthy dose of humor, and the occasional unpopular opinion.

Some episodes will dig into the mechanics of a specific marketing strategy. Others will challenge conventional thinking, explore what's changing, or share lessons from the people doing the work.

Our goal is simple: Help you understand marketing well enough to make better decisions, avoid costly mistakes, and build a business that grows.

No fluff. No buzzword bingo. No magic formulas.

Just real talk, smart strategy, and marketing that actually works.

Operated by Staci Cretu, owner of rethougthtandco.com.

description: Ten years ago, youth from Standing Rock began running, carrying a petition and a message: Mni Wiconi, water is life. title: From Crisis to Crisis - The Archives
author: Michael Bailey
description:
In 2009, Michael Bailey and Jeffrey Taylor started a show called From Crisis to Crisis: A Superman Podcast. Their mission was to talk about all of the Superman comics published between Man of Steel #1 in 1986 and Adventures of Superman #649 in 2006. They didn't quite get there but racked up an impressive 270 episodes and got all the way to the wedding. Back in 2025, Mike could no longer afford the hosting service that let the show continue to be listened to, but found this service and thought it would be a good way to get the show "back on the air" so to speak. 

So, whether you were a long time listener or have never heard an episode, here is the archive for From Crisis to Crisis. Listen to Mike and Jeff talk about Man of Steel (1986), The Supergirl Saga, Burn Out, Exile, The Brainiac Trilogy, Soul Search, Krisis of the Krimson Kryptonite, Time and Time Again, Blackout, Panic in the Sky, The Blaze/Satanus War, The Death and Return of Superman, The Battle for/Fall of Metropolis, Peer Pressure, Dead Again, The Death of Clark Kent, The Trial of Superman, Final Night and the Wedding. All of that and so much more was covered in these episodes, plus all of the interviews the boys conducted as well.

From the mysteries of time and the meaning of energy to the relationship between mind, matter, and perception, each conversation invites a closer look at what seems familiar—and the unexpected questions hidden within it.

What do we mean when we say something is real? How does language influence what we think we understand? Where do scientific explanations, philosophical reasoning, and direct spiritual experience meet, and where do their approaches lead in different directions?

With curiosity, depth, and a willingness to reconsider, Shayne and Devan follow ideas through their possibilities and contradictions, distinguish evidence from interpretation, and explore how even our most cherished explanations might open into something we have yet to imagine.

description: If you own commercial real estate and you're thinking about selling, refinancing, or stepping back from active management — this show is for you. Featuring David Kirkpatrick, founder and CEO of BLEND System LLC and executive director of AlumiTank, and Nathaniel Doddridge, senior vice president of fuel operations at Casey's, the series explores how generations of industry experience and collaboration led to a new approach to fuel additive dosing. 


Through its partnership with Casey's, the BLEND™ system has been field-validated across more than 500 loads and 3.5 million gallons of fuel treated as of the time of publication, demonstrating the need to improve safety, precision and efficiency in bulk petroleum transportation.

title: Les Miserables by Victor Hugo
author: Arthur Lane
description:
France, 1815. Jean Valjean leaves prison after nineteen years in the galleys, sentenced for stealing a loaf of bread. Hardened and shunned by society, he finds his life changed by one unexpected act of mercy. He swears to become an honest man, but his past will not let him go. Inspector Javert, a relentless officer of the law who believes no criminal can change, pursues him for decades.

Hugo’s epic of redemption, justice and love moves from the provincial towns of France to the slums, sewers and barricades of Paris. Along the way we meet Fantine, the abandoned mother forced into ruin. There is Cosette, the orphan girl enslaved by the cruel Thénardier innkeepers, and Marius, the young idealist torn between love and revolution. Gavroche, the fearless street urchin, joins the student uprising as it builds toward the June Rebellion of 1832.

First published in 1862, Les Misérables is a monumental work of French literature and historical fiction. It inspired the world-famous musical and countless film adaptations, and it remains a powerful story of poverty, conscience, faith and the struggle for human dignity.

Whether you are discovering the story for the first time or returning to it after the stage show or the film, this unabridged audiobook gives you Victor Hugo’s masterpiece in full, from the first page to the last.

This edition presents the classic English translation by Isabel F. Hapgood, first published in 1887 and admired for its faithfulness to Hugo’s original French.

title: The College Life Guide

description:
College is supposed to be some of the best years of your life, but that doesn’t mean it’s always easy. Have you ever felt stressed about classes, friendships, money, your future, or just trying to balance everything? Or maybe you just want to hear from other students who are going through the same things you are.
The College Life Guide, hosted by Jacob Chizek, is a weekly podcast made for college students, by college students. Each week, I bring on different guests to talk about their experiences and what college is really like. We cover everything from academics, friendships, stress, internships, and preparing for a career to going out, funny stories, mistakes, and the everyday ups and downs of being a college student.
As a college student myself, I understand a lot of the same things other students are dealing with because I’m going through them too. College has taught me that everyone has a different experience, and sometimes the best advice comes from hearing what other people have gone through. That’s why I started The College Life Guide—to give students a place to share their stories, advice, mistakes, and lessons they have learned along the way.
What makes The College Life Guide different is that it’s not just someone telling you how to succeed in college. It’s real students having real conversations about what college is actually like. Whether you’re already in college or getting ready to start, tune in each week for new stories, advice, laughs, and different perspectives on college life.

description:
Welcome to MORE THAN AN ATHLETE - the podcast where we talk about life and athlete's mental health beyond the game. Hosted by your very own Ruhani Singhnarula, an 11th grader at International School Bangkok and an aspiring athlete.


I decided to build this podcast because I know how isolating it feels when your identity can be tied to the sport that you play. As a student-athlete myself, we spend hundreds of hours training our bodies, but rarely get the space to talk about what goes on in our heads. 


In this podcast, I'll be able to sit down with fellow teammates, accredited sports vocalists, and psychology mentors to have raw, unfiltered conversations that sports culture usually ignores.

title: Per le altre | Chora Inchieste
author: Chora Media - Elisabetta Moro e Alessandra Vescio
description:
In Francia è da poco scoppiato il caso di Gisèle Pelicot quando le giornaliste Elisabetta Moro e Alessandra Vescio incontrano Anna, una delle donne che ha deciso di raccontare la sua storia,che, per certi versi, somiglia molto a quella di Pelicot.

Per sottomissione chimica si intende la somministrazione di sostanze a propria  insaputa, per ridurre la capacità di reagire e permettere l’abuso.

In Italia se ne parla poco, come se la violenza non esistesse.

In questo podcast, Elisabetta Moro e Alessandra Vescio indagano il fenomeno nel nostro Paese. Attraverso le voci di Anna, Stefania e Diana, che hanno scelto di condividere le loro esperienze, raccontano storie di fiducia tradita, dolore e giustizia mancata.

Ma raccontano anche altro: la fatica di essere credute, la forza di ricostruirsi e la determinazione di queste donne a rompere il silenzio, per sé e per tutte quelle a cui è successo e che non sono riuscite a parlarne. Perché ciò che resta invisibile non può essere riconosciuto né prevenuto. E perché cominciare a parlarne è il primo passo per cambiare lo sguardo: da chi subisce a chi agisce la violenza.


Le notizie dicono cosa è successo. Chora Inchieste prova a spiegare cosa c’è dietro. Ogni mese, circa, un’inchiesta per scoprire un lato inedito dell’attualità.
